title: Exotic theta terms in 2+1d fractonic field theory
summary: In this work, we study exotic theta terms in the 2+1d $φ$-theory, which provides a continuum description of the XY-plaquette model. The $φ$-theory can be viewed as a fractonic analogue of the 1+1d compact boson and exhibits momentum and winding subsystem symmetries. In this theory, discontinuous field configurations play a crucial role. Although such configurations spoil the naive topology of the field, they induce nontrivial backreactions that give rise to new topological terms.
